items.title: DK Metcalf: One catch in Week 8 win
items.text:
Metcalf brought in one of six targets for four yards in the Steelers' 27-6 win over the Browns on Sunday.

items.title: Dalton Kincaid: Leading receiver in Week 8 win
items.text:
Kincaid (chest) caught four of six targets for 86 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 36-10 win over the Ravens.

items.title: Aaron Rodgers: Modest production in Week 8 win
items.text:
Rodgers completed 13 of 25 passes for 172 yards with no touchdowns and one interception in the Steelers' 27-6 win over the Browns on Sunday.

items.title: Travis Kelce: Five grabs in Denver
items.text:
Kelce caught five of seven targets for 67 yards in Sunday's 28-24 loss to the Broncos.

items.title: Deshaun Watson: Over 300 passing yards in loss
items.text:
Watson completed 27 of 39 passes for 324 yards with no touchdowns or interceptions while rushing three times for two yards in the Browns' 27-6 loss to the Steelers on Sunday. He also lost a fumble.
